query: What does the evidence say about LLM agents for invoice reconciliation?

passages.text: In a pilot on 1,200 synthetic invoices, the agent matched 91% of line items to purchase orders without human help. Mismatches concentrated in invoices with partial deliveries.
passages.title: Synthetic Paper One: Agents for Accounts Payable

passages.text: The authors note that all experiments used a single vendor's invoice templates, so generalization to other layouts is untested.
passages.title: Synthetic Paper Two: Limits of Document Agents

passages.text: Human reviewers spent 40% less time per batch when flagged mismatches were pre-sorted by the agent.
passages.title: Synthetic Paper Three: Reviewer Workload

claims.text: A pilot on synthetic invoices reported the agent matched about 91% of line items without human help, with errors concentrated in partial deliveries.
Pre-sorting flagged mismatches reduced reviewer time per batch by roughly 40%, though results come from a single vendor's invoice templates and may not generalize.

limitations: The 91% figure comes from synthetic invoices, not production data.
